title: Checked variable-width signed reads omit sign extension
expected_behavior: For a signed n-byte integer (1 <= n <= 8), an all-0xff input denotes -1. Buf::try_get_int, try_get_int_le and try_get_int_ne should agree with get_int, get_int_le and get_int_ne on successful reads, and consume exactly n bytes.
actual_behavior: Reproduced on bytes 1.12.1, aarch64-apple-darwin, Rust 1.91.1, default-features=false: widths 1..7 return Ok(2^(8*n)-1), e.g. try_get_int(1) returns Ok(255), while the corresponding unchecked APIs return -1. Width 8 returns -1 for both. All six APIs leave exactly the expected suffix. These are finite native counterexamples, not formal theorem claims.
